name: SC64VITA
author: edenas
description:
SC64VITA is an unofficial, non-commercial, game-specific modification of DaedalusX64-vitaGL designed to improve StarCraft 64 compatibility on PlayStation Vita.
The application provides a dedicated standalone experience with direct game launching, a customized LiveArea interface, loading progress indication and a fixed PS Vita controller configuration.
The project includes game-specific graphics rendering and emulation timing improvements, native FlashRAM Save/Load support with persistent game saves, and recovery handling for save errors.
SC64VITA targets the USA revision-0 version of StarCraft 64. Occasional gameplay slowdowns and audio stuttering may occur.
